say:3:1320405001:0.text: How are you feeling, sweetheart? Nice and refreshed, I hope?
say:3:1320405001:0.source_cn: 怎么样，泡完温泉是不是有一种神清气爽的感觉？

say:4:1320405002:0.text: Totally! Knight Chippy is back at full strength. Hypogeans, bring it on!
say:4:1320405002:0.source_cn: 没错！骑士满满已经恢复最佳状态，就算再来一个军团的敌人...

say:5:1320405003:0.text: Oh, come now, no need for that! It's our absolute pleasure at the Frozen Paw to see you all taken care of.
say:5:1320405003:0.source_cn: 亲爱的，不用这么客气。能让客人满意，是我们白熊温泉旅馆...

say:6:1320405004:1.text: I was a bit worried the spring might be a little crowded, though.
say:6:1320405004:1.source_cn: 原本我还在担心泡温泉的人太多，不能让你们尽兴呢。

say:7:1320405005:0.text: It was a bit packed. Everyone wanted to soak a little longer... We barely managed to find a place to sit.
say:7:1320405005:0.source_cn: 人确实很多，大家又都想多泡一会儿……我们也是好不容易才...

say:8:1320405006:0.text: This festival has brought in quite the crowd, hasn't it?
say:8:1320405006:0.source_cn: 唉，谁能想到今年祭典会迎来这么多游客呢？

say:9:1320405007:0.text: That reminds me, I really need to start thinking about expanding the inn, and maybe even finding some new hot springs.
say:9:1320405007:0.source_cn: 这么说来，我得尽早把扩大旅店规模和寻找新温泉的事提上日程了。

choice_prompt:10:1320405008.text: Why, yes! With all these guests coming for our springs, we're running out of space.
choice_prompt:10:1320405008.source_cn: 这么说来，我得尽早把扩大旅店规模和寻找新温泉的事提上日程了。
choice_prompt:10:1320405008.male: Why, yes! With all these guests coming for our springs, we're running out of space.
choice_prompt:10:1320405008.female: Why, yes! With all these guests coming for our springs, we're running out of space.

say:11:1320405010:0.text: This area is rich with geothermal wonders. I'm sure there are plenty of hidden springs just waiting to be found.
say:11:1320405010:0.source_cn: 当然，雪松镇附近的地热资源非常丰富！按理说，肯定会有不...
say:11:1320405010:0.male: This area is rich with geothermal wonders. I'm sure there are plenty of hidden springs just waiting to be found.
say:11:1320405010:0.female: This area is rich with geothermal wonders. I'm sure there are plenty of hidden springs just waiting to be found.

say:12:1320405011:0.text: There's no simple way to track them down, and, oh, it's been giving me quite the headache.
say:12:1320405011:0.source_cn: 只不过，没什么好办法能探测这些温泉的位置，真是愁人。
say:12:1320405011:0.male: There's no simple way to track them down, and, oh, it's been giving me quite the headache.
say:12:1320405011:0.female: There's no simple way to track them down, and, oh, it's been giving me quite the headache.

say:13:1320405012:0.text: Say, sweetheart, you're a mage, aren't you? Think you could conjure up a little magic to help me with that?
say:13:1320405012:0.source_cn: ……对了，亲爱的，我记得你是魔法师吧？你知不知道有什么...
say:13:1320405012:0.male: Say, sweetheart, you're a mage, aren't you? Think you could conjure up a little magic to help me with that?
say:13:1320405012:0.female: Say, sweetheart, you're a mage, aren't you? Think you could conjure up a little magic to help me with that?

choice_prompt:14:1320405013.text: Sorry, magic doesn't work that way. For magic to help, the thing you're searching for needs its own magic. Hot springs... not so much.
choice_prompt:14:1320405013.source_cn: 是呀，如果想用魔法来探查位置，被探查的物品必须具有一定的魔力。寻找温泉……恐怕不行。
choice_prompt:14:1320405013.male: Sorry, magic doesn't work that way. For magic to help, the thing you're searching for needs its own magic. Hot springs... not so much.
choice_prompt:14:1320405013.female: Sorry, magic doesn't work that way. For magic to help, the thing you're searching for needs its own magic. Hot springs... not so much.

say:16:1320405015:0.text: Hmm.. do you think there's a device for detecting hot springs? Like a treasure-finding machine?
say:16:1320405015:0.source_cn: 唔……有没有勘察机器可用呢？就像是探寻宝藏的机器那样。
say:16:1320405015:0.male: Hmm.. do you think there's a device for detecting hot springs? Like a treasure-finding machine?

choice_prompt:17:1320405016.source_cn: 对哦！呼金就在雪松镇上，他最擅长制造这些稀奇古怪的东西了！

say:18:1320405016:0.female: Oh, right! He's in town, and he's an expert at building strange inventions!

say:19:1320405017:0.text: Are you talking about the dwarf craftsman in town?
say:19:1320405017:0.source_cn: 你们认识镇上的矮人工匠？

say:20:1320405018:0.text: Yes, Hugin's a friend of ours. He's a brilliant craftsman.
say:20:1320405018:0.source_cn: 嗯，呼金是我们的朋友。他可是位很厉害的工匠哦~

say:21:1320405019:0.text: Fantastic! I'm sure he could whip up something clever. Could you introduce us, sweetheart?
say:21:1320405019:0.source_cn: 太棒了！那就请你们帮我引荐一下吧，说不定他真能帮不小的忙呢。

say:22:1320405020:0.text: Of course, we'll take you to meet <style="highlight">Hugin</style> right away!

choice:14:0:1.text: There are no spells for that.
choice:14:0:1.male: There are no spells for that.
choice:14:0:1.female: There are no spells for that.

say:24:1320405014:0.text: That won't do. Our inn's reputation is built on natural hot springs. We can't fake it with magic.
say:24:1320405014:0.source_cn: 那可不行。我们旅店的招牌就是天然温泉，不能用魔法来欺骗顾客。
say:24:1320405014:0.male: That won't do. Our inn's reputation is built on natural hot springs. We can't fake it with magic.
say:24:1320405014:0.female: That won't do. Our inn's reputation is built on natural hot springs. We can't fake it with magic.

choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 魔法只能帮你改变水温
choice:14:1:2.male: It can only change the temperature.
choice:14:1:2.female: It can only change the temperature.

say:25:1320405008:0.source_cn: 是啊，慕名来泡温泉的人越来越多，房间不够可不行。
say:25:1320405008:0.male: Why, yes! With all these guests coming for our springs, we're running out of space.
say:25:1320405008:0.female: Why, yes! With all these guests coming for our springs, we're running out of space.

say:26:1320405009:0.text: Adding rooms is one thing, but finding more natural hot springs? That's the tricky part.
say:26:1320405009:0.source_cn: 不过这事也好办，扩建几间房子就够了。相比起来，去哪找新...
say:26:1320405009:0.male: Adding rooms is one thing, but finding more natural hot springs? That's the tricky part.
say:26:1320405009:0.female: Adding rooms is one thing, but finding more natural hot springs? That's the tricky part.
